summary: This is a physician termination letter from Dr. Christopher Rassekh, M.D. (Department of Otorhinolaryngology, Head and Neck Surgery, Penn Medicine / Hospital of the University of Pennsylvania) to a patient, dated October 10, 2024. The letter notifies the patient that the physician will no longer serve as their Otolaryngologist after November 10, 2024, citing a breakdown in the patient-physician relationship. content_blocks.title: Physician-Patient Termination Letter
content_blocks.content: A formal letter from Dr. Christopher Rassekh, M.D. (Penn Medicine, Department of Otorhinolaryngology, Head and Neck Surgery) to a patient (Mr. I), dated October 10, 2024. The physician states he will no longer serve as the patient's Otolaryngologist after November 10, 2024, due to a breakdown in trust. The letter notes: (1) an extensive ENT workup was performed with no clear ENT diagnosis found to explain the patient's symptoms; (2) a condition was recently diagnosed following a biopsy by a dermatologist, and follow-up with that doctor or a primary care physician is recommended; (3) the patient may seek other specialties as discussed via MyChart; (4) medical records will be forwarded with written authorization; (5) emergency care is available at the University of Pennsylvania Health System Emergency Department. This document contains no scientific data, experimental results, or biotech/TRL-relevant content.
